imageHeadline: Feeling off right after your wedding is real
imageSubtext: Post-wedding letdown affects nearly half of newly married women
pinTitle: Cold Feet on Your Honeymoon: Why Marriage Can Feel Wrong at First
pinDescription: Unexpected sadness or doubt right after getting married is more common than you think. Research shows postnuptial depression affects many newly married women—especially when family conflict or unmet expectations collide with the stress of a big event. What's happening, what it means, and what actually helps when you're in this space.
